searchText: few questions about the push method being talked about these days: 1) does the normal loop checking for eligible validators for withdrawals, dump the whole amount over 32ETH that is eligible? 2) how long would it take to cycle thru all valiadators who are eligible taking exit queues into account? 3) what happens when someone wants to exit 100%? (32+rewards) 1) Yes. 2) Still under consideration but in the current PR around 10 days (may be 7, worth reading the PR for exact numbers). 3) The owner exits the validator. Firstly, thank you! re (3) - would it then enter this push queue for consideration and then upon being hit, will get released the 32+rewards in the next push cycle? 4) how does one specify where the funds go to on the EL? (for most of us with 0x00 withdrawal credentials) 3) the funds would move to the execution layer as soon as the validator was withdrawable. 4) there will be a beacon chain operation to change 0x00 credentials to 0x01 credentials. what would be required to prove ownership for changing the 0x00? what happens to people who had their (CL) seeds stolen? They would need to send a beacon chain operation with a message containing the current public key and the desired execution address, signed by the current private key. Anyone with access to the private key can sign a message containing an execution address, and the first one that is included on the beacon chain is the only one which is acted upon. and to be clear -- the pubkey *behind the withdrawals credential hash* (rather than the active key)
